source.quote: 1M Context window: Nearly perfect at finding needles in the haystack with 1M-long context, with leading performance on long-context tasks like LongBench.

totalParams.value: 1.8 billion, 7 billion, and 20 billion parameter scales

source.quote: InternLM2.5, the 2.5th generation InternLM, has open-sourced a 7 billion parameter base model and a chat model tailored for practical scenarios.

trainingData.value: general domain data and domain-enhanced corpus; chat models further aligned with SFT and online RLHF

source.quote: InternLM2.5-7B: Further pretrain with general domain data and domain-enhanced corpus, obtaining state-of-the-art performance in evaluation with good language capability.

findings.text: Chat models are aligned with supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and online reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) for instruction following, chat, and function calling.

source.quote: InternLM2.5-chat-7B: Further aligned on top of InternLM2.5 through supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and online RLHF. InternLM2.5-Chat exhibits better instruction following, chat experience, and function calling, which is recommended for downstream applications.

findings.text: The card claims stronger tool use, including gathering information from more than 100 web pages (MindSearch / Lagent).

source.quote: Stronger tool use: InternLM2.5 supports gathering information from more than 100 web pages, corresponding implementation has be released in MindSearch.

findings.text: InternLM2.5-7B-Chat-1M is a 1M-long-context variant said to keep the same performance as InternLM2.5-Chat.

source.quote: InternLM2.5-7B-Chat-1M: 1M-long-context version of InternLM2.5-7B-Chat. InternLM2.5-Chat-1M supports million-word extra-long contextual reasoning while maintaining the same performance as InternLM2.5-Chat.

findings.text: Authors warn OpenCompass version changes may shift reported evaluation numbers.

source.quote: The evaluation data may have numerical differences due to the version iteration of OpenCompass, so please refer to the latest evaluation results of OpenCompass.

findings.text: Some comparison scores marked with * were copied from the original paper rather than re-run.

source.quote: * means the result is copied from the original paper.

findings.text: For 7B chat [MATH](https://arxiv.org/abs/2103.03874) (0-shot chain of thought), InternLM2.5-7B-Chat scores 60.1 versus Llama3-8B-Instruct at 27.9.
